title: Rezk completion by the equivalence-groupoid resolution
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, Kan complexes, homotopy fibers and weak homotopy equivalences from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the Kan model structure from [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper], and Reedy fibrancy and functorial Reedy replacement from [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure]. A simplicial space is a functor $W:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{sSet}$. In this statement a Segal space is Reedy fibrant and its consecutive-edge maps $W_n\to W_1\times_{W_0}\cdots\times_{W_0}W_1$ are weak homotopy equivalences for every $n\geq2$. Write $M_W(x,y)$ for the strict fiber of $(d_1,d_0):W_1\to W_0\times W_0$ at vertices $(x,y)$; Reedy fibrancy makes this a Kan complex representing the homotopy fiber. Its homotopy category $hW$ has the vertices of $W_0$ as objects, morphisms $\pi_0M_W(x,y)$, identities induced by $s_0$, and composition induced by the degree-two Segal map and $d_1$. Let $W_{\mathrm{eq}}\subseteq W_1$ be the union of components representing isomorphisms in $hW$. Call $W$ complete if $s_0:W_0\to W_{\mathrm{eq}}$ is a weak homotopy equivalence.

Let $I[m]$ be the groupoid with objects $0,\ldots,m$ and exactly one morphism between each ordered pair of objects. Let $E(m)$ be its ordinary nerve, regarded as a simplicial space discrete in its inner simplicial direction. Let $F(n)$ be the outer representable simplicial space, with $F(n)_k=\operatorname{Hom}_\Delta([k],[n])$ discrete. For a simplicial set $K$, write $cK$ for the constant simplicial space on $K$. For simplicial spaces $A,W$, define their cartesian internal hom by
$$(W^A)_{n,q}=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sS}}(A\times F(n)\times c\Delta^q,W).$$
Its operators are precomposition in $F(n)$ and $\Delta^q$. The functors $I[m]\to I[m']$ induced by order-preserving maps make $E(\bullet)$ cosimplicial. Define a simplicial space $\widetilde W$ by
$$\widetilde W_{n,q}=(W^{E(q)})_{n,q};$$
its inner simplicial operators act simultaneously on the resolution index and the inner index. The collapse maps $E(m)\to F(0)$ induce a natural map $W\to\widetilde W$. Choose a functorial Reedy fibrant replacement $\widetilde W\to\widehat W$, a levelwise weak homotopy equivalence, and denote the composite by $i_W:W\to\widehat W$.

For every Segal space $W$, the simplicial space $\widehat W$ is a complete Segal space. The map $i_W$ induces a weak homotopy equivalence $M_W(x,y)\to M_{\widehat W}(i_Wx,i_Wy)$ for every pair of objects, and every object of $h\widehat W$ is isomorphic to some $i_Wx$. The construction $W\mapsto\widehat W$ and the maps $i_W$ are natural in maps of Segal spaces.
